capabilities: Follow parent property through multiple levels
Use the note that embeds the base as root
Keep the visible Bases query and property columns
extras: Pro features require a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike.
intentEvidence: Add a Descendants view to a base. Choose a root note in the view options.
problem: Users need a way to visualize all related notes stemming from a root note within a Base query without manually linking every descendant.
summary: A view type for Bases that displays notes descending from a root note by following a specified parent link property through intermediate notes.
